mapper.select: SELECT a.program_list_idx, b.reservation_idx, a.program_name, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.use_time, a.homepage_id, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.application_people, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn, b.add_date FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND b.program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx} AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY a.reservation_date, a.use_time, b.add_date

SELECT a.program_list_idx, b.reservation_idx, a.program_name, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.use_time, a.homepage_id, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.application_people, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn, b.reference, b.add_date FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND b.member_id = #{member_id} AND b.cancel_yn = 'N' AND b.cancel_user_yn = 'N' AND SUBSTR(a.reservation_date, 0, 6) = #{reservation_date} ORDER BY a.reservation_date, a.use_time, b.add_date

SELECT program_list_idx, reservation_date, reservation_type, member_yn, program_name, use_time, notice, usage_agreement, homepage_id, total_people, enable_number_of_team, maximum_people_of_team FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST WHERE program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx}

SELECT a.program_list_idx, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.program_name, a.use_time, a.notice, a.usage_agreement, a.homepage_id, a.total_people, a.enable_number_of_team, a.maximum_people_of_team, b.reservation_idx, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.member_email, b.application_people, b.reference, b.usage_agreement_yn, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.reservation_idx = #{reservation_idx}

SELECT a.program_list_idx, b.reservation_idx, a.program_name, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.use_time, a.homepage_id, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.application_people, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn, b.reference, b.add_date FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY a.reservation_date, a.use_time, b.add_date

SELECT a.program_list_idx, b.reservation_idx, a.program_name, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.use_time, a.homepage_id, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.application_people, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn, b.reference, b.add_date FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.reservation_date,'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{plan_date},'YYYY-MM'), 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY a.reservation_date, a.use_time, b.add_date

SELECT a.program_list_idx, b.reservation_idx, a.program_name, a.reservation_date, a.reservation_type, a.member_yn, a.use_time, a.homepage_id, b.member_id, b.member_name, b.member_phone, b.application_people, b.approve_yn, b.cancel_yn, b.reference, b.add_date FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST a, EXP_RESERVATION b WHERE a.program_list_idx = b.program_list_idx AND b.program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx} AND a.homepage_id = b.homepage_id AND b.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY a.reservation_date, a.use_time, b.add_date

SELECT program_list_idx, reservation_date, reservation_type, member_yn, program_name, use_time, notice, usage_agreement, homepage_id, enable_number_of_team, total_people, maximum_people_of_team FROM EXP_PROGRAM_LIST A WHERE program_list_idx = #{program_list_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXP_RESERVATION ( reservation_idx, program_list_idx, member_id, member_name, member_pw, member_phone, member_email, application_people, reference, add_date, usage_agreement_yn, approve_yn, cancel_yn, homepage_id ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(reservation_idx),0)+1 FROM EXP_RESERVATION), #{program_list_idx}, #{member_id}, #{member_name}, #{member_pw}, #{member_phone}, #{member_email}, #{application_people}, #{reference}, SYSDATE, #{usage_agreement_yn}, #{approve_yn}, #{cancel_yn}, #{homepage_id} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EXP_RESERVATION SET member_id = #{member_id}, member_name = #{member_name}, member_phone = #{member_phone}, member_email = #{member_email}, application_people = #{application_people}, reference = #{reference}, modify_date = SYSDATE, modify_id = #{modify_id} WHERE reservation_idx = #{reservation_idx}

UPDATE EXP_RESERVATION SET approve_yn = #{approve_yn}, cancel_yn = #{cancel_yn}, modify_id = #{modify_id}, modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE reservation_idx = #{reservation_idx} AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
UPDATE EXP_RESERVATION SET cancel_yn = 'Y', cancel_user_yn = 'Y' WHERE reservation_idx = #{reservation_idx}
